categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Yupont Electric Power Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent electric power products, including smart meters, electricity information collection terminals, fault indicators, and communication modules. The company also provides intelligent inspection services, information technology services, and energy storage business. Its products and services cover power generation, transmission, transformation, distribution, and dispatching sectors, serving as a comprehensive electric power service provider.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as laser point cloud automatic classification, digital transmission line corridor technology, power data governance and application platforms, clock compensation calibration, wide current range design, modular embedded software platforms, and embedded hardware design. It employs automated intelligent production lines and smart testing equipment for manufacturing. The R&D focuses on AI, digital twin platforms, UAV autonomous inspection, and energy storage technologies including liquid cooling and wind cooling battery packs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include State Grid Corporation of China, China Southern Power Grid, and large power generation enterprises. The company mainly serves the electric power industry, including provincial and municipal power companies under the national grids. Its products and services support new-type power system construction, digital grid development, and carbon neutrality initiatives.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant business in regions such as East China, North China, Central China, South China, Southwest, Northeast, Northwest, and Southeast China. It has subsidiaries and operations in Beijing, Jiaxing, Guangdong, Wuhan, and other provinces. The company also has established subsidiaries in Hong Kong and overseas entities focusing on low-carbon energy technologies.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yupont Electric Power operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the electric power supply chain. It manufactures intelligent electric power equipment and provides inspection and IT services that support power grid operations and maintenance. The company also engages in energy storage system integration and solutions, positioning itself as a key technology and service provider within the power industry ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in intelligent electric power products, AI-enabled inspection technologies, digital twin platforms, and energy storage solutions. It emphasizes innovation in UAV autonomous inspection, laser point cloud data processing, and AI algorithms for defect detection. The strategic focus includes expanding energy storage capabilities, enhancing smart grid technologies, and supporting new-type power system and digital grid construction aligned with national carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent electric power products, energy storage systems, and related hardware. The company also earns income from providing intelligent inspection services and information technology services, including software development, system integration, and maintenance contracts. Some energy storage business revenues are recognized on a net basis due to agency arrangements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yupont Electric Power is a leading domestic supplier in intelligent electric power products and services, ranking among the top bidders in State Grid centralized procurement. It holds a strong market position in smart meters and intelligent inspection services, with competitive advantages in technology innovation and comprehensive service offerings. The company faces competition from numerous qualified enterprises in the power equipment sector but maintains a differentiated position through integrated hardware-software solutions and deep industry experience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 940 million, a 67.35% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 111 million, up 195.77%. R&D investment reached RMB 80 million, accounting for 8.52% of revenue. The company’s total assets grew to RMB 1.84 billion, with a stable growth trajectory supported by increased orders and expanding market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yupont Electric Power emphasizes advanced core technologies, high-precision and reliable intelligent electric power products, and integrated intelligent inspection solutions. Its products feature superior metering accuracy, multi-communication modes, low power consumption, and compliance with national standards. The company’s unique value lies in its comprehensive service chain from hardware manufacturing to AI-driven inspection and digital twin applications, enabling customers to enhance grid safety, efficiency, and digital transformation aligned with carbon neutrality objectives.
